name: Inma Kai ni Ochita Boku
source:
The protagonist goes to gather medicinal herbs to cure his mother's illness, but he ends up lost in the world of succubi. 

Will he be able to return safely to his original world without being corrupted by succubi?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ01259133.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
为了治好母亲的病，主人公出门采药，却不慎迷失在魅魔的世界。

他能抵挡魅魔的腐化，平安回到自己原来的世界吗？

［译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ01259133.html]DLsite[/url]］
